title: Mathematical formulations and a relax-and-fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems
core_idea: Formulate a novel capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problem with site-dependent facility failure probabilities and optional capacity increases for disruptions, by developing a non-linear mixed-integer programming model and its linear version, and propose a relax-and-fix heuristic to solve the NP-hard problem.
tldr: Develop mathematical (non-linear and linear) formulations and a relax-and-fix heuristic to model and solve capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems with site-dependent failure probabilities and capacity expansion under disruptions; evaluate via experimental instances and sensitivity analysis.
